evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Our analysis of existing Korean benchmarks reveals that most questions can be answered through factual recall alone, while those demanding greater application also differ in required knowledge, making it difficult to isolate application ability.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Existing Korean benchmarks for Large Language Models (LLMs) evaluate performance across diverse knowledge domains, but their accuracy scores cannot distinguish whether incorrect responses arise from a lack of required knowledge or a failure to apply that knowledge correctly.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments demonstrate that the resulting knowledge-matched sets largely satisfy the intended constraints, enabling controlled evaluation across diverse LLMs.
